about: Built from regions/ with the index. full = systems with a region row (all systems scanned before the slim rule, systems with detail_min_modules+ Salvaged Frigate Modules, unknown module counts); slim = module count only, to save space; pruned = scanned after the atlas reached atlas_cap systems with fewer than post_cap_min_modules modules (module count only). modules.histogram[m] = systems with m modules (unknown counts left out). regions: one array per region, see region_columns.
